S.FORM: == Malataw == Malataw ('Amis: Malatao/Malataw/Maladau/Maratoo :281; Kafalan: Maladaw/Matalel; Sakizaya: Maladaw; Dipong: マラタウ), o kawas no 'Amis, o nga'ayay pitooran, tada kawas no kakarayan. Onol O masowalay paratatengaan o kawas no kalalood ato kawas no pi'adop ci Malataw, o kapah itini i kalalifetan, pi'adopan, ano eca pakalitemoh ko fa'inayan to katalawan nira i, miceli' to ngangan nira to pidipot parihaday to tireng . I 'ayaw no kalalifetan a malalood o masinanotay ko faloco' mita'ong, mingitangit to kawas pa'icel sakapilowid a minokay, caay ko nian aca, ano caay ko nipatangican, tatiih a mitahidang to ngangan ni Malataw. Itini roma a niyaro', mapacakat ci Malataw a pala-cidal a kawas (tinako Kaliyawan no Kalingko) . Talawadaw a 'Amis/Pangcah O mama a tireng ci Malataw :22, o mama ko todong no folad, saka manga'ay nira mikowan ko no folad a malengaway, sera, kinaira, o'ol kadit a onol ato nipaloma'an to demak no 'orip, laloma'an ato tekedan :163 a Malataw, tana pakoloma' ahan ko cecay niyaro' i,o mikacaway to "niyaro'" cingra (no 'Atolan a sowal) , aci Dongi a mararamod, ciwawa ci cidal aci Foladan . No Kiwit a nisowalan a Malataw o cecay no ngasaw a kawas no sowal, maro' i kakarayan :25 No Kiwid a cipas no ka'etipay mi'adopay a kawas :84 Pasawali a 'Amis O polong no cidal, folad, fo'is ci Malataw :223. Cikasoan a 'Amis O kawakawas no sakalalood ci Malataw :27 Falangaw 'Amis Palidaw 'Amis Malataw o satakaraway a tadamaanay kawas, o lalengawan no kawakawas, mikowanay no serayan, mikowanay to kaloiraay a kawas; aci misanga'ay to kalomaamaan a Dongi mapolong mikowan to serayan kadademak ato caayay pitolas a 'orip , orasaka o polong no 'edaw ira ko pita'ong i ciiraan, tona ira to ko Kristokiw a tayni itiya, ci Malataw aci Dongi mapalecad to Kawas i kakarayan ato Ina Miliya . Sasowalan "Malataw" no to'as a sowal no 'Amis, naicowaay caay to ko kafana'en, nika paratatengan o i takaraway kawas, so'elinay kawas, tadakawas sanay ko kakiharan. Roma a niyaro', Malataw o "I kakarayanay a Kawas" saan ko pitahidang . Cengel O lodis no 'Amis enemay ko cengel a kohecalay, salongan maomahay kawas ci Malataw . Roma I pasaetip ko aro' ni Malataw, nawhani tadamaan ko paenararan, o sarakatay ni ta'ongan a kawas itira i kailisinan , citodongay i kakero'an a nipacakatan . Itini hikoki no sofitay i Kalingko, F-16 tatirengan no hikoki o cidal a palakawasan ni Malataw a losid . Pinengnengan a tilid. 2.Da lu za zhi she," (PDF). " (PDF). . 2009-06 (2022-04-18).
